Measures and interpretation

Statistics

How the comparison measures work

Pearson r

Correlation between the outcome and comparison variable in the same complete cells. It ranges from −1 to 1 and does not adjust for spatial dependence.

Outcome Moran’s I

Global clustering of the selected outcome using row-standardized queen neighbors. Positive values indicate similar values tend to be adjacent. No permutation p-value is reported.

Spatial-lag r

Correlation between each cell’s outcome and the average comparison value among its adjacent cells. It is descriptive and is not a causal estimator.

Bivariate map

Classifies cells as high or low relative to the current sample mean for both selected variables. Changing the state or land-share filter changes the cut points.

Complete pairs

Cells with numeric values for both selected variables. Unknown values are excluded; valid zeros remain in the calculation.

Land share

Share of the full hexagon intersecting the 50-state boundary. Use the 25% or 50% filter to test sensitivity to marginal coastal cells.
